note: Package 34: the default content of the Parameters block and the AC grid (UI data, not rules). A layout item of the classic profile may carry its own "cells" (rows of number ids) for the Parameters block; numbers = the sheet numbers of wp/model/sources.py. ac_grid = the 3x3 AC zones (cell ids of RULES/ac_zones.md; 5 = you). levels = the number hierarchy (UI_WISHES point 11): large / medium / small object names of the labels.
